content: pytest-markdown-docs 0.9.2 (March 2026, by modal-labs). Run with: pytest --markdown-docs. Tests Python code fences in .md files. Features: notest fence info string to skip a block; continuation marker to share state between adjacent blocks; globals injection via conftest.py pytest_markdown_docs_globals hook; named fixtures via fixture:<name> in fence info. Limitation: blocks that produce matplotlib figures need Agg backend and must not call plt.show(). For docs examples that import fdars, fdars must be installed in the test environment. Alternative: pytest-codeblock 0.5.8 is simpler. Recommendation: pytest-markdown-docs for this project because it supports globals injection and continuation blocks which the worked examples need.
